name: Blackberry-Py General ISSUE TEMPLATE
about: General Issue Template for All Issues
title: ""
description: ""
body:
  - type: input
    id: input-1
    attributes:
      value: " "
      label: Primary Issue
      description: Please Explain The Main Issue
      placeholder: When I ..., The application does ....
  - type: input
    id: input-2
    attributes:
      value: " "
      label: Expectation
      description: What is your expectation of the application when you complete the
        action mentioned in the previous section
      placeholder: I expect that application to ....
  - type: textarea
    id: textarea-3
    attributes:
      value: " "
      label: Value
      description: "What value does the Expectation provide to you as a user? "
